notes.title: Galaxy Champions TV - Golden Update
notes.notes:
Hello Champions!

I would like to announce that Galaxy Champions TV "Golden Update" is available now!
Follows the list of new features, changes and fixes:

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]40+ new upgrades.
[*]Score system is back!
[*]Global leaderboard: compete against other players from other platforms.
[*]Collection: collect all enemies and upgrades.
[*]New achievements.
[*]Difficulty levels: select difficulty before starting a run.
[*]Continue system: you have a limited amount of continues to beat the game.
[*]Loop: in Champions mode you can loop the game.
[*]Support more gamepad models.
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Replaced the skill tree with 60+ upgrades to create more replayability.
[*]Replaced the revive system with shared continues in co-op mode.
[*]Reduced amount of arena in each world, it makes the progress more solid and direct.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed gamepad detection issue.
[*]Fixed Vysnc and high frame rate issue.
[*]Fixed Steam Cloud sync issue with Linux and Mac.
[/list]

It took longer than we expected but the update is finally here! Hope you enjoy it! :)

Thank you very much everyone for the feedback, support and patience which made it possible for Galaxy Champions TV to get this far!

We are releasing the update with a special discount: [i]"I'd buy that for a dollar!"[/i] (almost) :D

Have a great week!

Best regards,

aQuadiun Team
